deviations_from_card: Per the revision, case 3 (drawn backwards) is dropped and cmp-prompt->cmp-catalog is a port through src/athena/core/prompt.py. To make that work, a port's from-file may import its port or declare it itself. An edge pointing AT the port (conn-service->conn-port, a structural implementer) is bound the other way: wiring.py imports the implementer. Beyond the card: an import edge may name one intermediate module in `through`, checked as two hops (from imports through, through imports to). It covers 10 edges carried by the daemon object (server.py), a base class (harness/rounds.py), a re-export (daemon/decisions.py), brain/store.py, lane/ports.py and core/prompt.py. Four edges the tree does not carry at all are REMOVED rather than annotated: daemon-sessions->catalog, daemon-connectors->conn-service, op-grammar->c-registry, fence->ids. voice-commands->approvals is re-pointed to voice-gateway->approvals. COUNTS.edges goes 123 -> 120 (-4 removed, +1 up edge), not only by adds and reverses as guard 8 phrased it. No component, system or concept was added, and lanes, tools and model guards are green. data/index.ts did not need changes. The skip population also includes 'planned, not in the tree' (the mcp-server edges). The scraper red-before was shown by moving the module aside (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
